title: tc-grade-distribution
description:
Assessment grades as counts, with how many were assessed, an optional bar in proportion and a grade picked as a
filter.

assessedLabel.description: What was assessed, after the count: "2 assessed"

grades.description: The grades in order, best first, each with its count

bar.description: Shows a bar in proportion under the counts

selectable.description: Grades can be picked as a filter

selected.description: The grade picked as a filter. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()
